week_notes: Side leans went 38-26-3 and total leans 39-28. Taking out games that chance decided, the sides were 31-23-3 (10 to chance) and the totals 26-26 (15 to chance). These counts include MISS @ OU, a week-11 game (OU 24-17) that also sits in the week-12 archive; without it the sides were 31-22-3 and the totals 26-25.

Average miss: on the margin the model 11.5 and the market 10.93; on the total the model 11.03 and the market 10.97. The market has been closer on margins in 11 of 12 weeks (week 11 was the only exception). On totals the two were about even.

Biggest real misses: UTEP @ AFA (UTEP +22 lean, model off by 31.3), NCSU 28-10 at FSU (model and market both off by about 28.5, with FSU missing both lead backs) and SDSU winning outright at BOIS as a 20.5-point underdog, with BOIS losing 3 turnovers.

Chance decided 24 of 67 games. Garbage time settled several totals: ORE @ MSU, GASO @ TROY, PITT @ LOU, WKU @ LIB, CCU @ UL, FIU @ KENN, CLT @ TLSA and UTEP @ AFA. Six draft verdicts marked "chance" for a quarterback exit were moved back to the merits. In those games the team that lost its quarterback still won or covered, or the quarterback who left was a backup (TENN, EMU, SYR, SHSU, STAN, HAW).

The pattern that repeated most: about a dozen teams' starting quarterbacks were out, benched or split time, and the board didn't price it (TA&M's Reed, TCU, ILL, CLEM, MSU, HOU, UNM, KSU, WYO, MD, UNC, PITT). Running-back absences were next (FSU, PSU, APP, USF, KU, TEM). The candidate check is when the board learns of a college starter change. It is a check, not a model change.

Players: 487 of 1,255 scored projections were met (39%), and 49% reached the model's typical number. 39 players left early and aren't counted. On the Best Matchups list, 10 of 33 picks met their projection, and 5 of 9 with a ladder cleared the books' O/U.
